Build-Depends: debhelper-compat (= 14), dh-sequence-single-binary, cmake, extra-cmake-modules, kwayland-dev, libkf6iconthemes-dev, libleptonica-dev, libtesseract-dev, libx11-dev, libxcb1-dev, pkgconf, qt6-base-dev, qt6-l10n-tools, qt6-multimedia-dev, qt6-scxml-dev, qt6-speech-dev, qt6-tools-dev
Description: simple and lightweight translator Crow Translate is a Qt application that allows you to translate and speak text using Mozhi, a front-end to multiple online translation engines, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. It can also recognize text in screen areas or images with Tesseract OCR or a vision model.
